Job Scheduling to Maximize Profit

Problem Statement:
You are given jobs with deadlines and profits. Schedule the jobs such that total profit is maximized. Each job takes a unit of time and only one job can be scheduled at a time.

Description:
Use Greedy and Disjoint Set Union (DSU) or sorting technique to solve the problem.

Input Format:
First line: n (number of jobs)
Next n lines: Job id, deadline, profit

Output Format:
A single integer representing the maximum total profit
